in_app_purchases.name: 言葉のお守り
in_app_purchases.review_note: Each purchase issues one shareable gift card containing one selected quote, a sender note, and a special background. The same customer may purchase additional gifts. Recipients can open and save gifts without any payment prompt.

localizations.description: 選んだ言葉とひとことを、大切な人へ贈る一回限りのお守りカードです。
